about_the_game:
You didn't plan on ending down here. Fleeing from the horrors outside, you escaped into a cave, only to discover the ruins of a once beautiful village, long overgrown and forgotten.

With nothing left but broken walls and scattered memories, its up to you to rebuild it. Grow food in the strange underground soil, rescue survivor, and create a safe haven where a new life can start. The deeper you go the more secrets you reveal, especially when night falls, and the underground world begins to glow with magic.


Features

Rebuild a forgotten Village

Clear rubble, repair houses, and bring new NPCs who unlock shops, services, and friendship

Survive & Thrive Underground

Farm glowing mushrooms, raise livestock, and craft the tools you need to start a new life.

Magical Day & Night Cycle

During the day, rebuild and grow. At night the cave transforms with glowing flora and mysterious events.

Customize & Build

Restore homes, decorate, and design a new community.

Wandering Trader

A mysterious merchant appears with rare goods and cosmetics.

Cooking, Crafting & Collecting

Experiment with recipes, restore artifacts for the museum, and chase achievements to unlock rewards & cosmetics.

A Cozy Survival Life Sim

A journey of growth discovery, and building something of your imagination.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1050 TI / AMD RX 570
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 64bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 8 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1050 TI / AMD RX 570
  • Storage: 10 MB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible

short_description: A cozy farming and life sim set inside a long forgotten cave. Restore a ruined village, farm unique crops, build and decorate, manage NPCs, collect items, earn achievements to unlock special rewards, and uncover magical changes between day and night.
